radiology_report:
Subject: Prostate Multiparametric MRI
Reporting Centre: OLVG Amsterdam
Date: 28 February 2025
Clinical context: PSA 11.0 ng/mL with a PI-RADS 5 designation.

FINDINGS:
Prostate parenchyma occupies a total volume of 31.6 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a sharply demarcated, markedly hypointense focus measuring 12 x 9 x 11 mm within the right peripheral zone at the mid-gland level. This area exhibits restricted diffusion on DWI with corresponding low signal intensity on the ADC map. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences show early, focal enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. Extracapsular extension, seminal vesicle invasion, suspicious lymphadenopathy, and osseous abnormalities are absent.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right mid-peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 31.6 mL; PSA density 0.35 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.833.

previous_notes.author: Dr. H. Martens (GP)
previous_notes.text: Clinical review on 13 March 2023 addressed a PSA increase to 6.3 ng/mL. Subsequent multiparametric MRI and systematic core biopsy yielded negative results for malignancy, with the encounter logged for ongoing urological monitoring.
